title: Get Local: Kind fits the card; the search hint on the palette
why: Jason's phone screenshot of Get Local, 2026-11-19 (St. Johns). (1) The Refine row's Kind box ran past the card at 390px: on phones each Refine label is a flex item that could not shrink below its select's widest option, and a long kind name made Kind wider than the card (there before 3c, which changed colours only). Now the label may shrink (min-width:0) and the select fills it, a long name cut inside the box. (2) The Find a business box's placeholder was the browser's blue-grey: now the palette's metadata colour, and shorter, "Business name or kind", so it fits at 390 (the box's spoken label keeps the full wording).

log.msg: Plan approved (no switch: everyone at once when published), advancing on schedule.
